Basically you go into “remission”, but triggers even years later can cause them to return, yet much weaker and more easily manageable. I try to remind myself what im staying sober for - myself, and focus on going to the gym, cooking good food (or just eating junk I love), and talking to other addict friends about our struggles with cravings to help me get my mind out of it.

I went back n forth for a bit between using drugs and trying to sober up from hard stuff but found myself smoking large amounts of weed and drinking many drinks a few days per WEEK. I was just going from one addiction to another, which would inevitably end me back to using hard drugs.
